title: Fixed Two Axis Open Maze Table
description: One newly authored complete static tabletop maze-game exterior. A deep grounded collection base and continuous outer support rim carry a whole open intermediate frame on front/rear pins. A separate complete maze tray is held on perpendicular side pins in one gently tilted pose; two distinct control knobs terminate the two axes. The tray has a single shared-vertex thick floor with three genuine through-drop apertures, four perimeter rails, fixed raised maze walls and one stationary display ball. All whole geometry is new, not the fixed inclined pinball cabinet with its targets replaced, a quarter-turn modular grooved track, or an abacus given a horizontal board. Three constant opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up, full horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One whole prop, zero scenes. Fixed illustrative pose only: no solved ball route, game rules, playable scoring, physics, axis motion through all angles, dynamic collision guarantees, controls or transfer mechanism, user fit, manufacture or toy-safety claim.
